description: National Center for Seismology earthquake information is a data repository run by National Center for Seismology, Ministry of Earth Sciences, India. The centre publishes a catalogue of recent and past earthquakes in and around India with location, depth and magnitude, along with seismic-network information and hazard products. Coverage: India and neighbouring regions. It is reached online through the home page and its search, download or service pages, in forms such as html; access is free of charge and open to view; downloads may need a free account. The licence is: terms set by the site, not read in this search. Caveats: the home page was opened on 2026-09-30 and only its title ("Official Website of National Center of Seismology") was read, so the holdings, the current terms and the availability of downloads were not browsed, and this description rests on the agency's publicly documented role and may lag the site. It can support earthquake exposure screening for infrastructure in India. Related records: no directly related record is catalogued yet.
